description: Alerts of the last 90 days, newest first, with pair, price, message, values at the alert, delivery per channel (sent, failed, held, muted …) and the price move afterwards. For chains with a take-profit (TP) and stop-loss (SL), trade has their settings at the alert and how it did as a trade: exit (target, stop, time, open), net result after fees in percent; running means still open, with the result so far. For the reasons behind one alert use explain_alert.

cursor.description: The value next of the previous answer, for the next page.

since.description: Only alerts from this candle close on, ISO 8601 such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z.
